_note: Narration, one entry per on-screen line. [r]/[g]/[t] colour the next word red/gold/teal. Lines in the same group stack; a new group clears the text.

lines.text: You've repented from the [r]same [r]sin so many times...
And a voice says: "What's the [r]point? He's [r]done with you."
The Prophet ﷺ described [g]exactly this person.
A servant [r]sins. He says, "My Lord, [g]forgive me."
And Allah says: "My servant [t]knew he has a Lord who [t]forgives." [g]Forgiven.
A [r]third time. Same sin. Same "forgive me." [g]Forgiven.
So the loop that [r]ruins you isn't "sin, repent, sin, repent."
Ibn al-Qayyim quotes one of the early scholars:
a person can commit a sin that takes him to [g]Jannah.
Because it keeps him [t]humble, ashamed, and [g]running [g]back to Allah.
So keep [r]fighting the sin. But never stop [g]coming [g]back.
"Do not [g]lose [g]hope in the mercy of Allah."
